     3	
     4	## Plan Context
     5	
     6	Address all actionable follow-up items from the `2026-05-31-orchestrator-sidecar-gui-resume-rework-2` synthesis, covering security hardening, a Python DRY refactor, GUI cache improvements, and a new jsdom test file.
     7	
     8	## Description
     9	
    10	Replace the unbounded `ProjectNameCache` IIFE in `utils.js` with a bounded version that evicts oldest entries when exceeding a 200-entry cap, and expose a `._size()` method for testing.
    11	
    12	## Scope
    13	
    14	- `mcp-server/gui/public/utils.js` — replace `ProjectNameCache` IIFE with bounded version
    15	
    16	## Deliverables
    17	
    18	- `ProjectNameCache` enforces a max-size cap of 200 entries
    19	- Oldest entries are evicted when the cap is exceeded (insertion-order tracking via `_keys` array)
    20	- `._size()` method exposed for testing
    21	- Existing `set()` and `get()` API preserved
    22	
    23	## Dependencies
    24	
    25	- None
    26	
    27	## Acceptance Criteria
    28	
    29	1. `ProjectNameCache` evicts entries when size exceeds 200 (AC-6).
    30	2. `ProjectNameCache._size()` returns the current entry count (AC-6).
    31	3. Existing `set()` and `get()` behavior is preserved — setting a key with a valid name stores it, getting a missing key falls back to slug extraction.
    32	4. Duplicate `set()` calls for the same key do not create duplicate entries in the order tracker.
    33	
    34	## Active Pipeline Stages
    35	
    36	`implementation` → `qa` → `code-review` → `documentation`
    37	
    38	## Estimated Complexity
    39	
    40	Medium
    41	
    42	## Rationale
    43	
    44	A max-size cap on `ProjectNameCache` is proportional to the risk (only matters in very long sessions with many projects). A simple 200-entry cap with `delete _cache[oldestKey]` is trivially simple and adequate — no full LRU data structure needed.
    45	
    46	## Rejected Approaches
    47	
    48	- *Full LRU with doubly-linked list:* Over-engineered for a UI cache that only matters in very long sessions.
    49	- *WeakRef-based cache:* More complex and less predictable eviction timing.
    50	- *Per-navigation clear:* Would cause visible re-fetch flicker on breadcrumb display.
    51	
    52	## Notes
    53	
    54	- This WP touches the same file (`utils.js`) as WP-004 (cache-key helper) — coordinate to avoid merge conflicts.
    55	- The 200-entry cap is far larger than the visible project count; eviction only triggers after navigating away from many projects.
    56	- Breadcrumb fallback (slug extraction in `get()`) ensures graceful degradation if an entry is evicted.
